title: Run a LinkedIn Lead-Magnet Funnel
summary: Post a free resource, collect the comments as leads in Notion, and keep your profile ready for the visits it brings.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell a B2B service; leads still need your follow-up to close.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (E) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Each comment becomes a tracked lead you can follow up.
A current profile converts more of the visitors a post sends you.
who_its_for: Founders, consultants and B2B sellers who post on LinkedIn.

steps: Run the profile audit and apply the edits you agree with.
